name: Melek Levni
source:
Formerly worked as Erik's maid.

She comes from a noble family in Turkey.

Although she was born blind, she can use her other senses to go about her daily life.

Although she can speak Turkish, Arabic, Kazakh, Greek, French and English, she cannot read braille in French.
